summary: DroneSecKB is an open, data-driven reference for unmanned-aircraft-system security. It brings the OWASP Drone Top 10, a live CVE register, a UAS-native attack taxonomy, and shippable detections together in one place.
why: Most UAV security knowledge is scattered across conference papers, vendor advisories, and blog posts. This project centralizes it, keeps the underlying data versioned and citable, and refreshes the CVE feed automatically so the reference stays current.

build_points.name: Data as the source of truth
build_points.summary: Every risk, CVE, technique, and detection is a record in versioned JSON under /data.

build_points.name: Counts that cannot drift
build_points.summary: All totals are computed from the data at build time, so the figures always match the records.

build_points.name: Live from NVD
build_points.summary: Drone and UAV CVEs are auto-ingested from the NVD API on a schedule, then merged into the register.

maintainer_note: Maintained by Sandesh More, a UAS and embedded security researcher credited on CVE-2023-49199 and CVE-2023-49200. The disclosures and methodology behind those entries are on the Research page.
